content.title: Cartwheel return policy
content.body:
# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides policy and the store's own policy page.

trace.text:
Here's a clear summary you can share with your customer:

### Returns (policy **cw-returns**)
- Customers have **30 days from the delivery date** (not the purchase date) to return an item.
- The item must be in the condition described in your store listing.
- Note: As a merchant, you can set your own return-window override if needed—check your store policy page for that.

### Refunds (policy **cw-refunds**)
- Once a return is approved and the order passes the eligibility check:
  - **$100 or less** → refund is processed **automatically**.
  - **Over $100** → refund is queued for **human review** before any money moves.
- Approved refunds go back to the **original payment method** and typically arrive in **5–10 business days**.

One extra thing worth knowing: any refunds issued during the week are **deducted from your next Friday payout** (policy **cw-payouts**).

Let me know if you need anything else!

results.title: Cartwheel shipping policy
results.snippet:
# Cartwheel shipping policy

Stores ship orders within 3 days of purchase. Standard delivery takes up to 7 days in transit after shipment. Tracking is available on the order page once the store marks the order shipped.

results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy
results.snippet:
# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.

results.title: Cartwheel dispute policy
results.snippet:
# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
